**B.** The appellate court will likely reverse, because the prevailing modern approach (the agency rule) does not attribute a co-felon's death from a police officer's or other third party's bullet to the surviving felon, even though his gunfire started the exchange. The shared note is wrong that proximate cause is universally adopted: it is one approach among several, and many jurisdictions reject it in favor of the agency rule.

CONFIDENCE: 65
